# Pull request checklist

> ⚠️ **Direct uploads are not possible** — only the repo owner has write access, and
> `main` is branch-protected: **every change must come in as a PR** (1 review, no force
> pushes). Please tick every box:

- [ ] I mostly added **links**, not copied files (link-first policy — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](/BucciMobile/SchachKenner/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] If I added a file under `data/`, `assets/` or `docs/`: the source license
      **explicitly allows redistribution**, and I added evidence to `licenses/`
      (verbatim quote + raw page copy in `licenses/raw/` + SHA-256 + retrieval date)
      and an entry in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](/BucciMobile/SchachKenner/blob/main/.github/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
- [ ] **No copyrighted material**: no books/PDFs, no commercial database dumps
      (ChessBase `.cbh`, chessgames.com/chess.com bulk), no annotated games, no
      unlicensed images
- [ ] All links work (the `link-check` workflow runs on this PR)
- [ ] AI assistance (if any) is disclosed here, and a human reviewed the content
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](/BucciMobile/SchachKenner/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [REMOVAL_REQUESTS.md](/BucciMobile/SchachKenner/blob/main/.github/REMOVAL_REQUESTS.md)
